# Documentation Templates Reference

Use these templates as starting points. Adapt as needed.

---

## Quickstart

```markdown
# Quickstart: [Title]

## Goal

[What success looks like]

## Prereqs

[What is required]

## Steps

1. [Do this]
2. [Then this]

## Verify

[Expected output or check]
```
